translationRepairs: In the first year of Guangda he was appointed director of the personnel bureau in the Ministry of Works.
In the first year of Guangda he was appointed director of the personnel bureau in the Department of State Affairs.
尚書吏部郎 is a personnel directorate under the Department of State Affairs (尚書省); Ministry of Works would be 工部, which the Chinese does not support.
In the first year of Guangda he was appointed Director of the Personnel Bureau in the Ministry of Works.
In the first year of Guangda he was appointed Director of the Personnel Bureau in the Department of State Affairs.
Same unit: 尚書吏部郎 belongs to 尚書省 (Department of State Affairs), not the Ministry of Works.

Before long he was appointed right vice director of the ministry of works; before he could assume the post he was additionally made palace attendant and transferred to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.

Before long he was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; before he could assume the post he was additionally made palace attendant and transferred to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
尚書右僕射 (and the following 左僕射) are vice directors of the Department of State Affairs; Ministry of Works is unsupported.
He was appointed director in the personnel bureau of the ministry of works; his post as commandant of footsoldiers remained unchanged, and he continued to attend the eastern palace.
He was appointed director in the personnel bureau of the Department of State Affairs; his post as commandant of footsoldiers remained unchanged, and he continued to attend the eastern palace.
尚書吏部郎中 is personnel bureau director under the Department of State Affairs, not the Ministry of Works.
He was transferred to right vice director of the ministry of works and soon to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
He was transferred to right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and soon to left vice director, with a share in personnel selection, while retaining his palace attendant rank.
尚書右僕射 / 左僕射 are Department of State Affairs vice directors; the English Ministry of Works misreads 尚書.
